question: Which of the following is NOT an amphibian animal?
solution:
The correct answer**__ is Tortoise__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the options, only Tortoise is NOT an amphibian.
 
• Tortoise comes under the category of **Reptiles.**
 
 
• Tortoise is the animal with the **longest life span.​**
 
• Like **other turtles, tortoises have a shell to protect from predation and other threats. **
 
• **The shell in tortoises is generally hard, and like other members of the suborder Cryptodira,**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Amphibians** can live in aquatic as well as terrestrial habitats.

 
 
• Most of the amphibians have two pairs of limbs.
 
• The amphibian's skin remains moist(without scales).
 
• The heart of an amphibian is** three-chambered.**
 
 
 
• Examples of amphibian are:
 
 
• Bufo (Toad).
 
• **Rana (Frog).**
 
• Hyla (Tree frog).
 
• **Salamandra (Salamander).**
 
• **Ichthyophis (Limbless amphibia).**
